description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named StaticContentController that manages static content files for a web application. It handles HTTP requests related to viewing, uploading, and deleting static content files, interacting with a ContentService and rendering views or JSON responses.

classes.name: StaticContentController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing static content files, including viewing, uploading, and deleting static files, with role-based access control.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve content images or static content management pages.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of static content files as JSON, including their paths and MIME types.

methods.name: saveFiles
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and save new static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a static content file.
